bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 收复 $412.5

read.en: TSMC rose 1.5% on Oct 23 to $418.51, trading between $411.15 and $421.31. It is below the falling 5-day ($421.6), 10-day ($426.2), 30-day ($442.4) and 100-day ($429.7) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($397.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($438.23), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 台积电 10月23日上涨 1.5%，收于 $418.51，盘中区间 $411.15–421.31。股价位于下行的 5 日（$421.6）、10 日（$426.2）、30 日（$442.4）和 100 日均线（$429.7）下方，高于上行的 200 日均线（$397.6）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$438.23），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $412.5 Sep 15 low, support again. Resistance is $419–421.9 (Jun 26 low, 5-day, Oct 22 high), then $426–430 (10 and 100-day) and $438 (SAR). Support is $412.5, then $405.2–411.2 (Aug 24, Oct 15, 22 and 23 lows) and $397.6 (200-day). A close above $421.9 would target $430; a close below $405 would open $397.6.
